name: Chart 1 partial sit-up: head and shoulders just high enough to see heels
identity_reference: sprites/docs/PHOTOREALISTIC_AVATAR_DIRECTION_2026-11-25.md; same immutable Chart 1 v2 blue/charcoal identity, not an older full-sit-up Flow clone

camera.description: Tripod side/very mild oblique 35 mm documentary view, full outstretched legs, shoulders, head, hands and shoes in frame on same track

rules: This is the original Chart 1 PARTIAL sit-up, not the full straight-leg sit-up already attempted in older Flow video 08
Lie on back, legs straight with feet roughly six inches apart and both arms at sides; feet, heels and pelvis do not slide
Lift head and shoulders clear of ground only far enough to see heels; do not sit upright or reach for toes
Return head, neck, shoulders and back to original resting posture, unchanged face/body proportions
Single continuous 35 mm photographic shot, no camera motion, cuts, fade, duplicate limbs, adult musculature, captions or sound

phases.pose: Supine; straight legs about six inches apart, heels grounded, arms resting by sides, back and head relaxed
Curl head and upper shoulders gently off track, pelvis and heels fixed, legs straight and arms still by sides
Head and shoulders clear floor just enough to see heels; torso remains mostly down and never becomes vertical
Gently uncurl to the identical supine beginning, both shoulders and head relaxed back on track, heels unmoved
